headline: Mistakes to Avoid When Replacing Your Doors
articleBody: Replacing your home's doors can make a huge difference in security, energy efficiency, and curb appeal, but it's easy to make a few common blunders. First off, don't just pick a door based purely on looks. While aesthetics are important, overlooking insulation values or durability for your climate can lead to higher energy bills and a shorter lifespan for your new door. Another mistake is neglecting the frame and hardware. A beautiful new door on a worn-out frame or with cheap locks is a recipe for disappointment and potential security issues. Think about how the new door will fit with your home's existing architecture – you want it to blend seamlessly, not stick out like a sore thumb. And trying to DIY such a precise job can often lead to costly errors and drafts.
